description: Agent-based diffusion of mask adoption on a small-world social-contact network with policy, media, enforcement, retail supply, and optional disease transmission feedback. Agents update beliefs via peers, media, prevalence signals; decide to wear and purchase masks subject to costs, fatigue, policy, and enforcement; and interact at locations where compliance is checked.

parameters.mobility_profile: Category probabilities by location type (workplace 0.35, school 0.15, retail 0.35, transit 0.15) modulated by age/employment/school status

parameters.assignment_rule: Greedy pack persons into households matching size distribution; household income=sum(members.income)

parameters.mask_policy: Follow Government.mandate_status when active; otherwise type-specific voluntary

parameters.mandate_status: False at t0; becomes True at policy_mandate_day until policy_lift_day

parameters.reach: Dirichlet(alpha=[2,2,2,...]) draws summing to 1.0 across outlets

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs the person-person social network using Watts-Strogatz small-world topology and assigns neighbors.

notes: Supports alternative network types if specified.

modules.name: GovernmentPolicy
modules.description: Issues or lifts mask mandate and disseminates policy awareness.

notes: Awareness also boosted via enforcement and media elsewhere.

modules.name: MediaCampaign
modules.description: Broadcasts messages influencing risk perception, attitudes, and trust.

notes: Positive field increases pro-mask attitudes and risk perception; negative reduces.
Mandate presence can be reflected in media bias through exogenous calibration if desired.

modules.name: BeliefUpdate
modules.description: Updates individual risk perception and attitudes from peers, media, and prevalence.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for person in Persons:
  peer_mask_mean = mean(Persons[n].current_mask_use for n in person.network_neighbors) if person.network_neighbors else 0
  # Update perceived prevalence toward community signal
  person.perceived_prevalence = (1 - prevalence_feedback_weight) * person.perceived_prevalence + prevalence_feedback_weight * signal.community_prevalence
  # Peer influence on attitude
  delta_att_peer = person.social_influence_weight * (peer_mask_mean - 0.5)
  # Media influence
  delta_att_media = signal.media_influence_field * (person.trust_in_authorities - 0.5)
  # Risk perception drifts toward prevalence and media
  person.risk_perception = clamp(person.risk_perception * (1 - risk_perception_decay) + prevalence_feedback_weight * signal.community_prevalence + 0.5 * max(0, signal.media_influence_field), 0, 1)
  # Trust adapts slowly to alignment with peers/media
  person.trust_in_authorities = clamp(person.trust_in_authorities + trust_update_rate * sign(delta_att_media), 0, 1)
  person.attitude_toward_masks = clamp(person.attitude_toward_masks + delta_att_peer + delta_att_media, -1, 1)
emit signal.updated_beliefs = True
notes: Risk perception and trust bounded to valid ranges.

modules.name: RetailMarket
modules.description: Manages mask stock, price, and sales across retailers.

update_rule.pseudocode:
total_demand = sum(intent.quantity for intent in signal.mask_purchase_intentions)
# Price adjustment (linear elasticity): pct_change = elasticity * (demand - supply)/supply
total_stock = sum(r.stock_level for r in Retailers)
excess_demand = max(0, total_demand - total_stock)
pct_change = price_elasticity * (excess_demand / max(1, total_stock))
for r in Retailers:
  r.price_per_mask = max(0.1, r.price_per_mask * (1 + pct_change))
# Fulfill purchases
sold = 0
for intent in shuffled(signal.mask_purchase_intentions):
  r = argmin_r price_per_mask among retailers with stock
  if r.stock_level >= intent.quantity:
    r.stock_level -= intent.quantity
    sold += intent.quantity
    Persons[intent.person_id].mask_inventory += intent.quantity
# Restock
for r in Retailers:
  restock_qty = Poisson(supply_restock_rate * population_size / retailer_count)
  r.stock_level += restock_qty
emit signal.masks_sold_today = sold
emit signal.avg_price_today = mean(r.price_per_mask for r in Retailers)
emit signal.stock_levels = [r.stock_level for r in Retailers]
notes: Simple market clearing with rationing if stock is scarce.
Elasticity negative implies price rises with excess demand.

modules.name: AdoptionDecision
modules.description: Agents decide whether to wear a mask today and whether to purchase masks given inventory and perceived benefits/costs.

update_rule.pseudocode:
purchase_intentions = []
for person in Persons:
  # Utility of wearing a mask
  benefit = 0.6*person.risk_perception + 0.3*max(0, person.attitude_toward_masks) + 0.1*int(signal.mandate_status)
  expected_penalty = int(signal.mandate_status) * enforcement_probability * fine_amount * (1 - person.policy_awareness*0.5)
  cost = cost_sensitivity * signal.avg_price_today + person.fatigue_level + 0.2*max(0, -person.attitude_toward_masks) + expected_penalty*0  # penalty affects non-use, so 0 here
  p_wear = sigmoid((benefit - cost - person.compliance_threshold) / max(1e-3, decision_temperature))
  will_wear = Bernoulli(p_wear) and (person.mask_inventory > 0)
  person.current_mask_use = int(will_wear)
  if will_wear:
    person.mask_inventory = max(0, person.mask_inventory - mask_consumption_rate)
  # Purchase decision if low inventory
  if person.mask_inventory < 1:
    base_p = base_purchase_probability
    p_buy = clamp(base_p + 0.5*benefit - 0.3*signal.avg_price_today*cost_sensitivity, 0, 1)
    if Bernoulli(p_buy):
      qty = purchase_pack_size
      purchase_intentions.append({person_id: person.id, quantity: qty})
  # Fatigue update
  person.fatigue_level = clamp(person.fatigue_level + (0.5 if will_wear else -0.3) * fatigue_rate, 0, 1)
emit signal.mask_purchase_intentions = purchase_intentions
emit signal.adoption_state = [p.current_mask_use for p in Persons]
notes: Sigmoid decision with temperature allows heterogeneity around thresholds.
Expected penalty indirectly increases p_wear by raising benefit of compliance (modeled as mandate indicator).

modules.name: MobilityAndContact
modules.description: Generates daily visits to locations and contact events for compliance monitoring and (optional) transmission.

notes: Contact_rate_modifier of locations can be applied by scaling counts per type if desired.

modules.name: PolicyEnforcement
modules.description: Applies compliance checks and sanctions at locations, updating awareness and counting enforcement actions.

notes: Sanctions increase awareness; fines can be modeled by decreasing available income if required.

modules.name: DiseaseTransmission
modules.description: Optional disease sub-model updating infection prevalence using mask efficacy and contacts.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if not disease_model_active:
  emit signal.community_prevalence = Community.infection_prevalence
  emit signal.Rt_estimate = None
  return
# Simple SIR-like update using contacts
new_infections = 0
for (pid, lid) in signal.contacts:
  # Pick a random other contact at same location for simplicity
  other = random_contact_at_location(lid)
  if Persons[pid].health_status == 'S' and Persons[other].health_status == 'I':
    eff = base_transmission_prob * (1 - mask_efficacy_source_control*Persons[other].current_mask_use) * (1 - mask_efficacy_wearer*Persons[pid].current_mask_use)
    if Bernoulli(eff):
      Persons[pid].health_status = 'I'
      new_infections += 1
# Recoveries (fixed 10-day infectious period)
recoveries = 0
for person in Persons:
  if person.health_status == 'I':
    person._days_infected = person._days_infected + 1 if hasattr(person,'_days_infected') else 1
    if person._days_infected >= 10:
      person.health_status = 'R'
      recoveries += 1
# Update prevalence
I = sum(1 for p in Persons if p.health_status == 'I')
Community.infection_prevalence = I / population_size
# crude Rt estimate: new_infections / recoveries (smoothed)
Rt = (new_infections + 1) / max(1, recoveries)
emit signal.community_prevalence = Community.infection_prevalence
emit signal.Rt_estimate = Rt
notes: Toy model sufficient for directionally correct feedback; can be swapped for SEIR.
Transmission probabilities modified multiplicatively by mask use.

modules.name: HouseholdNorms
modules.description: Aligns attitudes and behaviors within households via within-group influence.

notes: Strength controls convergence toward household norm.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily observables and computes derived indicators.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption_rate = mean(signal.adoption_state)
compliance_by_loc = signal.compliance_by_location_type
masks_sold = signal.masks_sold_today
enforcement_actions = signal.enforcement_actions_today
prev = signal.community_prevalence
Rt = signal.Rt_estimate
avg_price = signal.avg_price_today if exists else mean(r.price_per_mask for r in Retailers)
# Inequality index by income (Gini of mask adoption propensity by income quantiles)
groups = quantile_groups(Persons, by='income', q=5)
adopt_by_group = [mean(Persons[i].current_mask_use for i in grp) for grp in groups]
ginequality = gini(adopt_by_group)
emit observable.adoption_rate_daily = adoption_rate
emit observable.compliance_by_location_type_daily = compliance_by_loc
emit observable.masks_sold_daily = masks_sold
emit observable.enforcement_actions_daily = enforcement_actions
emit observable.infection_prevalence_daily = prev
emit observable.Rt_daily = Rt
emit observable.avg_price_daily = avg_price
emit observable.inequality_index_by_income = inequality
notes: Gini computed over group means to capture between-group disparity.

algorithms.WattsStrogatz: Generate small-world graph with N, k, p.
algorithms.GranovetterThresholdWithSigmoid: Adoption probability via sigmoid around individual threshold given utilities.
algorithms.PriceAdjustmentWithElasticity: Adjust retail price proportional to excess demand using elasticity.
algorithms.SimpleSIRContactProcess: Contact-based infections with fixed infectious period and mask-modified transmission.
algorithms.GiniIndex: Compute inequality across group means: G = sum_i sum_j |xi - xj| / (2 n^2 mean(x)).
